說明: 《千秋硯》卷五〈羯陵伽〉生圖清單（回一）。畫風、節點、尺寸沿用卷一清單。注意：孔雀王朝時代的衣著是不縫製的棉布（腰布與披肩），房子是竹子、泥巴與棕櫚葉；不要出現後世的蒙兀兒風格、圓頂、石造神廟或現代服裝。阿育王是真實歷史人物，只畫遠景或背影，不畫正臉。

items.name: 達雅河
items.prompt: Ancient eastern India (Kalinga, modern Odisha) around 261 BC, during the Kalinga War of the Mauryan emperor Ashoka: a wide muddy brown river winding between bright green rice paddies under heavy grey monsoon clouds, a low dark rocky hill in the distance, plumes of smoke rising from several burnt fields, reeds along the bank, no people in the foreground, sorrowful and quiet. People of the Mauryan period wear simple unstitched white or undyed cotton garments (dhoti and a shawl over the shoulder), some with turbans, bare feet or simple sandals; houses are bamboo, mud and thatch with palm-leaf roofs. No later Mughal or medieval elements, no domes, no stone temples, no modern clothing.
